resources.string:
Created by Ms. Dyanne S. Roncales, this app aims to enhance students' math skills and problem-solving abilities through a variety of engaging activities. The carefully crafted exercises promote critical thinking and build confidence, making the learning process enjoyable and effective.


📘 This educational tool was created to help address the PISA numeracy gap by offering fun, offline, and inclusive learning opportunities — especially for areas with limited internet access.


🔒 Data Privacy Notice: MaTHech does not collect, share, or transmit any personal data. All learning progress is stored locally on your device in full compliance with the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (Republic Act No. 10173).
This app does not collect or share any personal data. All progress is stored locally on your device.
